get.description: Uses the same query parameters as /features, but omits GeoJSON coordinates. COP should use this for dashboards, lists and readiness previews.

get.summary: Return density grid cells for low-zoom situation rendering
get.description: Uses the same query parameters as /features, but groups returned features into stable WGS84 grid cells and omits original geometries. COP should use this for dense low-zoom layers before requesting detail or original geometry on drill-down.

parameters.name: cellSizeDegrees
parameters.description: Stable WGS84 grid cell size in degrees. Aliases `gridDegrees` and `grid` are also accepted. When omitted, SIM derives a safe size from the query bbox span.

parameters.name: maxCells
parameters.description: Maximum density cells returned after sorting by count and severity.

parameters.name: sampleSize
parameters.description: Maximum sample feature ids included in each grid cell for COP drill-down.

get.summary: Return a modelled per-tower mobile coverage viewshed
get.description: Builds an on-demand radial GeoJSON overlay for one OSM communications_tower reference. The output is an estimated terrain-aware radio reach, not confirmed operator BTS/NOC state or an RF-planning product.

parameters.name: technology
parameters.description: Technology for the modelled reach. Defaults to 4G.

parameters.name: radiusM
parameters.description: Requested radius in metres. SIM clamps unsafe values.

parameters.name: includeNoSignal
parameters.description: Include sectors with quality=none. Defaults to false so COP renders only estimated reach; use true only for diagnostic radial-grid display.

parameters.name: includeRaw
parameters.description: Include debug-only model internals. COP should not request this for normal operator display.

SimulatorOperationsProviderSection.description: Server-side provider payloads used by the authenticated SIM operator UI.

lifecycle.description: Production services are included in SIM readiness and SLO rollup; future services are diagnostic only.

productionReadiness.description: True when service health contributes to the production readiness rollup.

document.description: URL or path to the authoritative source-neutral COM Map Catalog provider document.

streamId.description: Opaque provider stream id consumed by the COM backend; it is not a public browser URL.

doNotRenderGeometryFill.description: When true, polygon geometry is metadata extent only and must not be displayed as a filled vector feature.

selectableInMap.description: Whether COM may expose the whole source as a normal map selection. Prefer layer metadata for user-facing selection.

backend.description: Optional backend marker, e.g. unconfigured, patroni-postgis, chmi-opendata or ndic-srti-lod, without exposing credentials.

environmentGrid.description: Cataloged grid/field layer health, stable WGS84 grid alignment and upstream status.

boundaryReadModel.description: PostGIS administrative boundary read-model health, import age and feature count.

layerId.description: Recommended COM catalog layer id, e.g. public.mobile.network.

rendering.description: Provider-side rendering contract for geometries that are grid cells or raster extents rather than ordinary vector polygons.

transportMode.description: Normalized public-transport or road mode, e.g. bus, tram, train, metro, trolleybus, road.

routeShortName.description: Normalized route or line short name for transit vehicles.

destination.description: Normalized destination/headsign when provided by the source.

delaySeconds.description: Normalized delay in seconds when provided by the source.

vehicleId.description: Stable provider vehicle identifier for transit vehicles.

tripId.description: Provider trip identifier for transit vehicles.

occupancyStatus.description: Normalized GTFS-style occupancy status when provided by the source.

occupancyPercent.description: Vehicle occupancy estimate in percent when provided by the source.

speedMps.description: Vehicle speed in metres per second.

dataQuality.description: Indicates whether the mobile assessment is based on measurements, modelled coverage, both, or insufficient inputs.

btsStatus.description: Status of the concrete BTS/operator feed. `operator_feed_unavailable` means SIM has no authorized BTS/NOC status.

sensitiveUse.description: True for generic military templates. The profile still must not contain classified or operationally sensitive parameters.

typeCode.description: Canonical SIM provider v2 type code, for example weather.temperature.high, weather.ice.slippery_roads, hydro.flood.warning or air_quality.pm10.smog.

sourceCode.description: Authoritative upstream phenomenon code, for CHMI alerts typically the SIVS eventCode such as I.2, VII.1, XI.2 or SMOGSIT.PM10.

sourceSystem.description: Upstream code system used for sourceCode, for example CHMI_SIVS.

localized.description: Localized provider text blocks keyed by language, for example cs and en. SIM uses this to avoid duplicate map features per CAP language.

providerProperties.description: Provider-native audit metadata. CHMI CAP alerts include schemaVersion=sim.provider.v2, taxonomy, localized, presentation, notification and cap blocks.

SituationDataBbox.name: bbox
SituationDataBbox.description: WGS84 bbox in west,south,east,north order. Defaults to configured Prague pilot bbox.

SituationDataTechnologies.name: technology
SituationDataTechnologies.description: Optional mobile coverage/mobile network technology filter. Alias `technologies` is also accepted.

SituationDataOperators.name: operator
SituationDataOperators.description: Optional mobile coverage/mobile network operator filter. The unified mobile_network layer currently publishes aggregate/unknown operator assessment.

SituationDataTowerId.name: towerId
SituationDataTowerId.description: OSM communications_tower identifier as exposed in mobile coverage tags, e.g. node:13743393126.

SafetyDataMinSeverity.name: minSeverity
SafetyDataMinSeverity.description: Minimum safety severity to include in notification candidates.

SafetyDataIncludeStale.name: includeStale
SafetyDataIncludeStale.description: Include stale safety features as notification candidates.

SafetyDataHydroStationId.name: stationId
SafetyDataHydroStationId.description: CHMI hydrological station objID, or station DBC code when unique in metadata.

SafetyDataHydroDetailFrom.name: from
SafetyDataHydroDetailFrom.description: Inclusive start of the requested station detail time window. Defaults to configured past horizon.

SafetyDataHydroDetailTo.name: to
SafetyDataHydroDetailTo.description: Inclusive end of the requested station detail time window. Defaults to configured forecast horizon.

SafetyDataHydroDetailSeries.name: series
SafetyDataHydroDetailSeries.description: Comma separated series IDs. H=water level, Q=discharge, TH=water temperature, H_F/Q_F=forecasts.

x-csm-sim.source: Composite generated from archived service-local YAML snapshots.
notes: Current runtime error responses may use correlationId; requestId unification is a compatibility-safe follow-up.
